subject: Request: VM proofbook & audit schedule — deliverables for SIG packet
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finsight.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: audit_team@finsight.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM proofbook & cadence for SIG packet

Hi Jordan,

Finsight is preparing for its SIG intake next month and we need a consolidated vulnerability management proof packet from Redwood covering the past 12 months. At minimum we need:

- A single workbook that lists scan cadence (external/internal/containers), scan teams, and tool versions used.
- Per-CVE remediation timelines (created -> triaged -> patched/deployed) for critical/high severity findings for the last 12 months.
- The SLA policy you publish for CVE remediation (critical/high/medium/low) and any documented exceptions.
- Evidence stubs: scan snapshots (JSON), patch manifests, and an attestation signed by an authorized Redwood lead.

Can you confirm scope and whether you can deliver a draft workbook + DocuSign attestation by Mar 22? If that date is tight, please propose an alternate. Also note: the auditor will want a short narrative for any CVEs that exceeded SLA in that window.

Thanks — we can accept the packet via Drive link and DocuSign.

—Olivia
Olivia Chen
Security Assurance Manager, Finsight Capital

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finsight.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM proofbook & cadence for SIG packet

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the consolidated workbook and the attestation. Plan below: 

1) Deliverables and owners
   - VM proofbook workbook (tabbed): Laura Bennett (scan cadence, tool versions, snapshots)
   - CVE remediation timeline CSV and short narratives: Kimberly Park (remediation evidence + exceptions)
   - Signed attestation (DocuSign): Jordan Blake (exec-signed attestation)

2) Proposed SLA summary (we will include the policy text in the workbook):
   - Critical: 7 days to remediation/rollback or apply compensating control
   - High: 14 days to remediation or mitigation plan
   - Medium: 30 days
   - Low: 90 days

3) Delivery schedule
   - Draft workbook + scan snapshots (Drive link) by Mon, Mar 22 EOD PST
   - Final workbook + DocuSign envelope by Thu, Mar 25 EOD PST

A couple quick clarifying Qs so we scope exactly what you need:
- Do you want authenticated internal host-level scans included as separate tabs or summarized? (we recommend separate tabs for internal vs external vs container)
- For the CVE timeline, do you want fields: discovered_date, ticket_id, triage_owner, remediation_date, deploy_date, evidence_link?

If the auditor wants anything else, loop us in and we’ll append. I’ll assign tasks and push a draft Drive link to you on Mar 22.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations (interim) — Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:54:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM proofbook & cadence for SIG packet

Jordan / Olivia — quick technical note for the workbook content. I will produce the scan cadence tab and attach snapshot pointers. Summary below (I will include tool versions in the workbook metadata cell):

- External vulnerability scans: weekly (Unauthenticated Nessus + Nmap for surface mapping); snapshot retention: 90 days exported JSON.
- Internal host scans: monthly authenticated agent-based scans (Qualys agent fleet) + weekly rolling sampling for critical assets; snapshot retention: 180 days.
- Container images (CI): image scanning on push (Trivy) prioritized for services in prod; weekly full cluster scans (K8s) for platform namespaces.
- IaC static scan: weekly (Checkov) included as evidence but not part of CVE timelines unless linked to deployed CVEs.

SLA enforcement and exception handling (we will include the exception log tab with brief narratives):
- Critical: remediation or documented compensating control within 7 days; if rollback required, emergency patch window invoked (24–72hr deploy).
- High: patch or mitigation within 14 days. If a dependency blocks the patch, we document temporary mitigations and plan.
- Medium: 30 days.
- Low: 90 days.

I’ll attach the initial workbook to the Drive folder and include scan-snapshot-20270301.json as the example snapshot. Kimberly — can you prepare the remediation timeline CSV and short narratives for the 12-month window?

Laura Bennett
Director, Security Operations — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finsight.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: audit_team@finsight.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VM proofbook & cadence for SIG packet

Thanks Jordan and team — received the drive link and the workbook draft (looks good). A couple quick notes:

- The auditor confirmed they only need the remediation timeline fields you suggested (discovered_date, ticket_id, triage_owner, remediation_date, deploy_date, evidence_link).
- They also asked for a short narrative on five CVEs that exceeded SLA (we saw three high and two medium in your exception tab). Please attach the narratives as a PDF or include as an inline sheet in the workbook.

I opened the DocuSign envelope and assigned it to your legal sig role. Once signed we’ll mark the packet as received for SIG intake.

Olivia
